splash._comment_resizeMode: cover fills the entire screen — no white bars on any device ratio.

updates._comment: 0 = never wait for an OTA update on launch. App opens instantly from cache.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Meskeny requests camera access to let you photograph and record property listings, and for profile and identity verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Meskeny needs permission to save property photos and videos to your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Meskeny needs access to your photo library to let you upload property images and profile photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Meskeny uses your location to show properties near you and provide accurate map views. Your location is never shared with third parties.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Meskeny uses your location to show nearby properties.
infoPlist._comment_backgroundModes: Required for socket keepalive and background uploads.

android._comment_softwareKeyboardLayoutMode: pan = content shifts up; resize = layout shrinks. pan avoids layout jumps.
